name: io.github.blasrodri/truth
title: truth — agent fact-checker
description: Deterministic fact-checker for AI coding agents. Verifies an agent's claims about its own work (routes/functions/config/deps added, removed, or changed) against the real code, the working-tree git diff, and logs. Returns cited Supported/Contradicted/Refused verdicts; refuses to bluff. Runs locally — code never leaves the machine.
